require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

define('MOJARRAD_PLAYGROUND_SEED',true);
require WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/mojarrad-core/demo/demo-seed.php';
if(!file_exists(WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/mojarrad-core/demo/smoke.php')) {throw new RuntimeException('Role smoke tests missing');}
